page_title: ENG 6-2 IRN | England v Iran 21/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' Raphael Claus is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+13' 6 - 2 Goal! Mehdi Taremi (Iran) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Jordan Pickford to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
90+12' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+12' The Iran players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+10' Referee Raphael Claus makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Iran. Let’s see what happens!
90+10' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Iran for a penalty. Play continues.
90+8' Sardar Azmoun (Iran) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the crossbar. Unlucky!
90+8' 14:6 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90+4' Jude Bellingham (England) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Hossein Hosseini, who smothers the ball.
90+2' The attendance is 45334.
90' There will be a minimum of 10 min. of added time.
90' 6 - 1 It's 6:1! Callum Wilson feeds Jack Grealish (England) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
88' Hossein Hosseini is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Luke Shaw (England). Easy save!
84' Luke Shaw (England) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
84' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Phil Foden (England) is thwarted and cleared to safety. England get a corner.
83' A nice individual effort by Marcus Rashford (England) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
82' Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
80' Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
77' We are about to witness a substitution. Sardar Azmoun (Iran) is replacing Ahmad Noorollahi.

77' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and England will have a goal kick.
75' Gareth Southgate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Callum Wilson (England) replacing Harry Kane.
75' The England players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
71' 5 - 1 Marcus Rashford (England) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Hossein Hosseini with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 5:1.
70' Substitution. Raheem Sterling makes his way off the pitch and Jack Grealish (England) comes on as his replacement.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Phil Foden (England) will replace Mason Mount.
70' Gareth Southgate prepares a substitution. Bukayo Saka is replaced by Marcus Rashford (England).
70' Harry Maguire (England) is leaving the field of play after that knock to his head, as Eric Dier runs on as his replacement.

70' Ahmad Noorollahi (Iran) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and England will have a goal kick.
66' Looks like Harry Maguire (England) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
65' 4 - 1 What a finish! Mehdi Taremi (Iran) picks up the ball after finding some space inside the box, then fires it in off the crossbar.
63' Here is a change. Milad Mohammadi is going off and Carlos Queiroz gives the last tactical orders to Mehdi Torabi (Iran).
62' 4 - 0 GOAL 4:0! Bukayo Saka (England) brilliantly slaloms his way forward past a few defenders and unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which is deflected and goes into the back of the net.

61' Saeid Ezatolahi (Iran) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and England will have a goal kick.
60' Luke Shaw (England) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
57' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luke Shaw (England). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
56' Raheem Sterling (England) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to England.
55' Kieran Trippier (England) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
55' Declan Rice (England) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. England win a corner kick.
54' Kieran Trippier (England) launches a cross from the corner, but Hossein Hosseini is alert to thwart the effort.
54' Jude Bellingham (England) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play. England are awarded a corner kick.
51' Kieran Trippier (England) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
51' Harry Kane (England) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
49' Harry Kane (England) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
48' Morteza Pouraliganji (Iran) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Raphael Claus didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
48' Morteza Pouraliganji (Iran) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. England have a free kick from a promising distance.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Roozbeh Cheshmi comes off for Hossein Kanaani (Iran).
46' Carlos Queiroz has made a change at the break. Ali Gholizadeh has come on in place of Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran).
46' The game is over for Ali Karimi (Iran). Saeid Ezatolahi comes on for the second half.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+15' Raphael Claus blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+11' Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) receives a nice lofted pass and rips a snap shot from the edge of the box. His kick misses the goal and flies high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for England.
45+6' England seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45+4' A dangerous looking corner kick from John Stones (England) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+1' 3 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Harry Kane plays it into the box, and Raheem Sterling (England) gets on the end of the cross to put it inside the right post. 3:0.
45' 14 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

43' 2 - 0 What a hit! Bukayo Saka (England) makes a run to receive the ball and produces a powerful shot from mid-range which deflects in off the inside of the right post, beating the surprised goalkeeper.
43' The referee awards a corner and Luke Shaw (England) goes over to take it.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Mason Mount (England) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
40' Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
39' Kieran Trippier (England) sends a long ball in, but Hossein Hosseini comfortably gathers the ball.
35' 1 - 0 Goal! Jude Bellingham (England) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Luke Shaw and easily beat the keeper with a header into the top right corner from close range. 1:0.
33' Harry Maguire (England) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
32' Kieran Trippier (England) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
32' Raheem Sterling (England) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now England have a corner.
30' Mason Mount (England) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Iran will have a goal kick.
27' Bukayo Saka (England) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Hossein Hosseini is equal to it and makes an easy save.
27' The ball is cleared after Bukayo Saka (England) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' Alireza Jahanbakhsh (Iran) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Raphael Claus had an easy-decision to make.
23' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Ahmad Noorollahi (Iran) but poses no threat.
21' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Ehsan Hajsafi (Iran), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
21' Kieran Trippier (England) trips an opposition player and Raphael Claus signals a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Iran.
20' It looks like Alireza Beiranvand may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Carlos Queiroz replaces him with Hossein Hosseini (Iran).
17' It doesn’t look good for Alireza Beiranvand (Iran); looks like he’ll be heading for an early bath!
14' Alireza Beiranvand (Iran) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
9' Alireza Beiranvand (Iran) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

8' Harry Maguire (England) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Harry Kane, but his first-time effort flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Iran will have a goal kick.
7' Mehdi Taremi (Iran) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Raphael Claus has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. England are awarded the free kick.
5' Alireza Beiranvand (Iran) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for England.
3' Harry Maguire (England) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
3' The corner by Kieran Trippier (England) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Iran.
3' Luke Shaw (England) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to England.
1' The England players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Iran will kick-off.
Raphael Claus is the one to supervise the game today.
